mapper.sql: id, row_version, generation_job_id, media_plan_id, visual_beat_id, item_key, attempt_number, execution_status, provider_operation_id, media_asset_id, request_fingerprint, error_code, error_detail_ref, review_status, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at, shot_id, order_index, leaf_generation_job_id, take_id, frozen_input_json, frozen_input_fingerprint
mapper.select: INSERT INTO media_generation_items (id, generation_job_id, media_plan_id, visual_beat_id, item_key, attempt_number, execution_status, provider_operation_id, media_asset_id, request_fingerprint, error_code, error_detail_ref, review_status, reviewed_at, shot_id, order_index, frozen_input_json, frozen_input_fingerprint) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{generationJobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{mediaPlanId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{visualBeatId}, #{itemKey}, #{attemptNumber}, #{executionStatus}, #{providerOperationId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{mediaAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{errorCode}, #{errorDetailRef}, #{reviewStatus}, #{reviewedAt}, #{shotId}, #{orderIndex}, #{frozenInputJson}::jsonb, #{frozenInputFingerprint}) RETURNING id

SELECT i.* FROM media_generation_items i JOIN generation_jobs j ON j.id = i.generation_job_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = j.project_id WHERE i.generation_job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND p.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.order_index, i.item_key, i.attempt_number
mapper.update: UPDATE media_generation_items SET leaf_generation_job_id = #{leafJobId}, take_id = #{takeId}, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND leaf_generation_job_id IS NULL AND shot_id IS NOT NULL AND execution_status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE media_generation_items SET execution_status = #{status}, media_asset_id = #{assetId}, error_code = #{errorCode}, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND shot_id IS NOT NULL AND execution_status NOT IN ('READY','FAILED','CANCELED') AND (execution_status, media_asset_id, error_code) IS DISTINCT FROM (#{status}, #{assetId}::uuid, #{errorCode})

UPDATE media_generation_items i SET review_status = #{decision}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = i.row_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM generation_jobs j JOIN projects p ON p.id = j.project_id WHERE i.id = #{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND i.generation_job_id = j.id AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND i.row_version = #{rowVersion} AND i.execution_status = 'READY' AND i.review_status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW'
